summary.en: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said today it is continuing Operation Thunderbolt and Operation Skynet to combat rodent infestation across Hong Kong. Launched on November 4, Operation Thunderbolt had, as of November 19, carried out targeted inspections at 1,433 locations, identifying 282 rat holes and harbourage places, capturing 161 live rodents and collecting 119 dead rodents, with baiting and sealing completed at 162 locations. At Station Lane Sitting-out Area in Kowloon City, officers captured 12 live rodents and treated eight nests; at Fung Cheung Road Garden in Yuen Long, they collected 17 dead rodents and destroyed seven nests. The third phase of Operation Skynet, targeting food premises in shopping malls, conducted 1,996 inspections at restaurants and other high-risk spots and 1,369 inspections at other food premises, issuing hundreds of vermin elimination and cleansing notices and launching 176 prosecutions.

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said at the Hong Kong Export Credit Insurance Corporation's 60th anniversary reception tonight that Hong Kong's exports rose 45% in the first nine months of this year, mainly driven by AI-related electronics. Since the corporation was set up in 1966, the government's guarantee has grown from HK$300 million to HK$80 billion, and it has underwritten more than HK$2.6 trillion of business for over 20,000 policyholders across more than 200 markets. Insured export sales hit a record HK$192 billion last fiscal year. Chan said the Government and the corporation will support exporters by expanding underwriting capacity, responding faster and broadening coverage, and will help mainland enterprises go global.
summary.zh_hans: 财政司司长陈茂波今晚出席香港出口信用保险局60周年酒会时表示，今年首九个月香港出口上升45%，主要由人工智能相关电子产品带动。信保局自1966年成立以来，政府担保额由3亿港元增至800亿港元，至今已为逾20,000名保户、逾200个市场承保逾2.6万亿港元业务，上财政年度承保出口销售更创纪录达1,920亿港元。陈茂波表示，政府与信保局会从加大承保能力、加快反应及扩大覆盖三方面支援出口商，并协助内地企业出海。

summary.en: Hong Kong Customs yesterday shut down a suspected drug repacking and distribution centre in Tuen Mun and a suspected drug manufacturing centre in Tsuen Wan, seizing about 3.7kg of suspected cannabis buds, 3.6kg of suspected cannabis oil, about 24kg of cannabis-infused candies and 1,148 suspected cannabis oil vape capsules, along with packaging and manufacturing paraphernalia, with a total estimated market value of about HK$1.6 million. Three people were arrested. A 23-year-old man and a 28-year-old woman were each charged with two counts of trafficking in a dangerous drug, while a 33-year-old man was charged with two counts of trafficking and one count of manufacturing a dangerous drug. The case will be heard at Sha Tin Magistrates' Courts tomorrow. Under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, drug trafficking carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.
summary.zh_hans: 香港海关昨日捣破屯门一个疑似毒品重新包装分销中心及荃湾一个疑似制毒中心，检获约3.7公斤疑似大麻花、3.6公斤疑似大麻油、约24公斤大麻糖果及1,148粒疑似大麻油烟弹，连同一批包装及制毒工具，市值约160万港元，共拘捕3人。被捕的23岁男子及28岁女子各被控两项贩毒罪，33岁男子被控两项贩毒及一项制毒罪，案件明日于沙田裁判法院提堂。根据《危险药物条例》，贩毒最高可判罚款500万元及终身监禁。

summary.en: International Infrastructure Excellence Week 2026 opened in Hong Kong today, with its flagship event, the 2nd International Infrastructure and Projects Leaders Summit, drawing infrastructure leaders and experts from more than 30 countries and regions. Participants praised Hong Kong's achievements in infrastructure. A representative of Qatar's Public Works Authority said Hong Kong has rich experience in planning and delivering major infrastructure and that Qatar will use Hong Kong as a benchmark. A senior partner at Deloitte Australia described the Northern Metropolis as one of the most anticipated projects of its kind in the world. A Hong Kong Polytechnic University professor said Hong Kong's infrastructure is well-developed, of a very high standard and sustainable, able to meet future challenges.
summary.zh_hans: 国际基建卓越周2026今日开幕，旗舰活动第二届国际基建项目领导峰会吸引来自30多个国家或地区的大型基建项目领袖和专家参与。一众参加者肯定并赞扬香港在基建方面的成绩。卡塔尔公共工程局代表表示，香港在规划和交付大型基建方面拥有丰富经验，当地会以香港作为基准。澳洲德勤资深合伙人形容北部都会区是全球同类计划中其中一个最令人期待的项目。理工大学教授指香港基建完善、水准极高且具可持续性，能应对未来挑战。
summary.zh_hant: 國際基建卓越周2026今日開幕，旗艦活動第二屆國際基建項目領導峰會吸引來自30多個國家或地區的大型基建項目領袖和專家參與。一眾參加者肯定並讚揚香港在基建方面的成績。卡塔爾公共工程局代表表示，香港在規劃和交付大型基建方面擁有豐富經驗，當地會以香港作為基準。澳洲德勤資深合夥人形容北部都會區是全球同類計劃中其中一個最令人期待的項目。理工大學教授指香港基建完善、水準極高且具可持續性，能應對未來挑戰。

summary.en: The Immigration Department mounted territory-wide anti-illegal worker operations from November 13 to 19, including a joint operation with police codenamed "Windsand" and a joint operation with Customs, police, the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department and the Leisure and Cultural Services Department around Kai Tak Sports Park during mega events on November 13-15 and 17, targeting illegal workers, mobile hawkers selling infringing goods and ticket scalping. Five suspected illegal workers — one man and four women aged 21 to 31 — were arrested. The department reminded visitors that taking employment in Hong Kong without the Director of Immigration's permission is an offence punishable by a maximum fine of $50,000 and two years' imprisonment.
summary.zh_hans: 入境处11月13日至19日在全港多区采取连串反非法劳工行动，包括与警方代号「风沙」的联合行动，以及与海关、警方、食环署及康文署在启德体育园附近的联合行动，在11月13至15日及17日的大型活动期间打击非法劳工、流动小贩售卖侵权物品及炒卖门票等活动，共拘捕5名怀疑非法劳工。被捕者为1男4女，年龄21至31岁。入境处提醒，访客未经入境处处长许可不得在港工作，违者一经定罪最高可罚款5万元及监禁两年。

summary.en: The Home and Youth Affairs Bureau held a symposium at the Hong Kong Trade Development Council's Entrepreneur Day 2026 today and set up a pavilion for the Alliance of Hong Kong Youth Innovation and Entrepreneurial Bases in the Greater Bay Area, showcasing the Alliance's support and entrepreneurial opportunities in the Greater Bay Area to young entrepreneurs. Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs Alice Mak said in her opening remarks that the Government attaches great importance to youth development, and that the first Five-Year Plan stresses expanding youth opportunities and encouraging young people to seize opportunities in the Greater Bay Area. The Alliance, jointly established in December 2023 by the Bureau, the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the People's Government of Guangdong Province and the Department of Human Resources and Social Security of Guangdong Province, now has about 70 member organisations, with bases covering all nine mainland cities of the Greater Bay Area; it has organised more than 480 activities in nearly three years, and four new members joined at the symposium.
summary.zh_hans: 民政及青年事务局今日在贸发局「创业日2026」举办专题研讨会，并为「大湾区香港青年创新创业基地联盟」设置展馆，向青年创业者介绍联盟支援及大湾区创业机遇。局长麦美娟致开幕辞时表示，政府重视青年发展，首份五年计划强调增加青年发展机会，鼓励青年把握大湾区机遇、追逐梦想。联盟由民青局、广东省政府港澳办及广东省人社厅于2023年12月共同成立，现有约70个成员机构，基地覆盖大湾区九个内地城市，成立近三年来举办逾480项活动，今次研讨会亦欢迎4个新成员加入。
summary.zh_hant: 民政及青年事務局今日在貿發局「創業日2026」舉辦專題研討會，並為「大灣區香港青年創新創業基地聯盟」設置展館，向青年創業者介紹聯盟支援及大灣區創業機遇。局長麥美娟致開幕辭時表示，政府重視青年發展，首份五年計劃強調增加青年發展機會，鼓勵青年把握大灣區機遇、追逐夢想。聯盟由民青局、廣東省政府港澳辦及廣東省人社廳於2023年12月共同成立，現有約70個成員機構，基地覆蓋大灣區九個內地城市，成立近三年來舉辦逾480項活動，今次研討會亦歡迎4個新成員加入。

summary.en: Two incoming passengers were sentenced at the West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts today to five to six months' imprisonment and fined $1,000 to $2,000. A 47-year-old mainland woman intercepted at Hong Kong International Airport on April 14 had 26,000 duty-not-paid cigarettes in her baggage, worth about $106,000 with a duty potential of about $86,000; she was jailed for five months and fined $1,000. A 58-year-old mainland man intercepted at the airport yesterday had about 40 duty-not-paid cigarettes and 40,000 alternative smoking products in his baggage, worth about $120,000; he was jailed for six months and fined $2,000. Customs welcomed the sentences, saying custodial terms carry a considerable deterrent effect.

summary.en: Hong Kong Customs yesterday detected a case in which a local company conducted a cash transaction for a watch containing precious metals and stones valued at over HK$120,000 without being a Category B registrant under the Dealers in Precious Metals and Stones Regulatory Regime; the investigation is ongoing. Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance, anyone carrying on a business dealing in precious metals and stones with transactions totalling HK$120,000 or more must register with Customs; a non-Category B registrant carrying out a cash transaction of HK$120,000 or more commits an offence punishable by a maximum fine of HK$100,000 and six months' imprisonment. Customs reminded dealers they must obtain registration before carrying out any cash or non-cash transaction of HK$120,000 or more.
summary.zh_hans: 海关昨日侦破一宗贵金属及宝石交易商案件，一间本地公司在未成为B类注册人下，以现金交易一只价值逾12万港元、含贵金属及宝石的手表，调查仍在进行中。根据《打击洗钱及恐怖分子资金筹集条例》，从事贵金属及宝石交易、总值12万港元或以上的交易须向海关注册；非B类注册人进行12万港元或以上现金交易即属违法，一经定罪最高可罚款10万港元及监禁六个月。海关提醒交易商，进行12万港元或以上现金或非现金交易前必须先取得相关注册。
summary.zh_hant: 海關昨日偵破一宗貴金屬及寶石交易商案件，一間本地公司在未成為B類註冊人下，以現金交易一隻價值逾12萬港元、含貴金屬及寶石的手錶，調查仍在進行中。根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》，從事貴金屬及寶石交易、總值12萬港元或以上的交易須向海關註冊；非B類註冊人進行12萬港元或以上現金交易即屬違法，一經定罪最高可罰款10萬港元及監禁六個月。海關提醒交易商，進行12萬港元或以上現金或非現金交易前必須先取得相關註冊。

summary.en: Hong Kong stocks fell for a fourth consecutive day to their lowest in more than a year and a half. The Hang Seng Index fell more than 530 points intraday to 22,307 before closing at 22,410, down 430 points or 1.89%, with main-board turnover of nearly HK$270.3 billion. The Tech Index fell nearly 5% intraday before closing at 3,511, down 3.78% and at a more than two-year low. Most ATMXJ stocks fell 1% to 3%, but Alibaba rose more than 3% after better-than-expected results, the best performer among Hang Seng and Tech constituents; Kuaishou and NetEase fell more than 11% and nearly 18% respectively after results, the worst two constituents. The Hang Seng is down nearly 5.2% this week and the Tech Index nearly 8%.

summary.en: The Census and Statistics Department said today that the Composite Consumer Price Index rose 2.2% year on year in October 2026, up from 1.9% in September, mainly because the rates concession ended in September. Netting out the effects of the Government's one-off relief measures, underlying inflation was 2.0%, slightly below September's 2.1%. By component, electricity, gas and water rose 12.7%, miscellaneous services 5.0% and transport 4.5%, while basic food fell 0.8%; the CPI(A), CPI(B) and CPI(C) rose 2.0%, 2.2% and 2.3% respectively. In the first 10 months of 2026, the Composite CPI rose 1.8% over the same period a year earlier.

summary.zh_hant: 政府統計處今日公布，10月綜合消費物價指數按年升2.2%，升幅較9月的1.9%擴大，主要因為差餉寬免於9月結束。扣除政府一次性紓緩措施影響，基本通脹率為2.0%，略低於9月的2.1%。按類別計，電力、燃氣及水升12.7%，雜項服務升5%，交通升4.5%，基本食品跌0.8%；甲類、乙類及丙類消費物價指數分別升2%、2.2%及2.3%。今年首十個月合計，綜合消費物價指數按年上升1.8%。

summary.en: The Northern Metropolis Development Ordinance was gazetted today. The Ordinance provides the legal basis for facilitation measures covering town planning, land compensation, building works approvals, noise control and cross-boundary flows, to speed up development and help enterprises set up in the Northern Metropolis. The Legislative Council passed the bill at its third reading on November 12. The Development Bureau is preparing the first batch of subsidiary legislation for LegCo vetting in January, to take effect in the first quarter of 2027. The Northern Metropolis will be developed as a university town and innovation and technology hub, and as Hong Kong's main platform for engaging in Greater Bay Area development and integrating into national development.

summary.en: Secretary for Justice Paul Lam said today at the 16th Business of IP Asia Forum that the National 15th Five-Year Plan prioritises innovation and stronger intellectual property protection and utilisation, supporting Hong Kong in deepening its status as an international legal and dispute resolution services centre and a regional IP trading centre; the Chief Executive's Policy Address also commits to developing Hong Kong as a premier regional IP trading hub. Speaking at the breakout session 'Turning Creativity into Economic Value: Clearing Legal Roadblocks in IP Commercialization', Lam cited local cultural and creative industries, noting that film IP can drive tourism — the 'Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In' exhibition turned cultural buzz into economic value — and that the Hong Kong Palace Museum's Ancient Egypt exhibition drew more than 670,000 visitors and spawned about 170 original merchandise items that have generated more than $33 million in revenue for the Museum. The Government introduced the Inland Revenue (Amendment) (Tax Deductions for Intellectual Property Expenditure) Bill 2026 into the Legislative Council last month, and Hong Kong ranks seventh globally in IP rights protection in the World Competitiveness Yearbook 2026.

summary.en: The Hospital Authority and the Fire Services Department announced today that the Pre-hospital Stroke Diversion Scheme will extend from the New Territories to all districts in Kowloon and Lantau Island from 8.30am on November 23. Ambulance personnel who assess a patient as having a suspected large vessel occlusion stroke will convey the patient directly to a designated hospital in the service catchment area, eliminating interhospital transfer time. The scheme was first launched on December 15 last year in the New Territories East and West clusters, and as at August 31 this year 145 patients with suspected large vessel occlusion stroke had been conveyed directly to Prince of Wales Hospital and Tuen Mun Hospital, with the average time from ambulance departure to treatment shortened by about 80 minutes per patient. After the extension, patients will be taken directly to Princess Margaret Hospital, Queen Elizabeth Hospital or Kwong Wah Hospital according to their district.

summary.en: The Housing Bureau said today the latest Composite Waiting Time for Subsidised Rental Housing is 4.4 years, down 0.4 years from 4.8 years at the end of June and below 4.5 years for the first time, hitting a 10-year low. Compared with the 6.1-year peak before the current-term Government took office, it is 1.7 years shorter. The figure is the average waiting time of general applicants housed to public rental housing or Light Public Housing in the 12 months to end-September 2026. The bureau said it is confident of meeting the target of reducing the waiting time to 4.5 years in 2026-27. About 11,200 general applicants were housed in the third quarter of 2026, and average public housing production over the next five years will exceed 35,000 units a year, up about 73% and the highest in 25 years. As at end-September 2026, there were about 96,100 general applications for public rental housing, down nearly 40% from the peak of 156,400 in September 2020, a 15-year low and the first time the figure has fallen below 100,000 since 2012.

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan today addressed the first Canadian Indo Pacific Business Summit in Hong Kong, saying the city's economy grew 5.1% over the first nine months — the fastest pace for that period in five years — with goods exports up 30% in the third quarter, private consumption up 2.9% and investment up 7.5%; full-year growth is forecast at 4.8%, underlying inflation at 1.7% and unemployment at 3.8%. In the first 10 months, 121 companies listed in Hong Kong, raising over HK$400 billion. Chan set out three areas for Hong Kong–Canada co-operation: capital — Canada aims to catalyse C$1 trillion of investment at home in five years, while Hong Kong has about HK$42 trillion under management and more than 3,300 family offices; resources — Canada ships about one million tonnes of LNG to Asia a month, while Hong Kong is building gold and commodities trading capacity; and innovation and talent — more than 320,000 people have arrived through talent schemes since the end of 2022. He also noted about 300,000 Canadians live in Hong Kong, and that China and Canada agreed during the APEC meetings in Shenzhen to expand mutual tariff relief and extend their trade arrangement to the end of 2028.
summary.zh_hans: 财政司司长陈茂波今日在首届加拿大印太商业峰会致辞，指出香港经济首九个月增长 5.1%，是五年来同期最快，第三季货物出口升 30%，私人消费升 2.9%，投资升 7.5%；全年增长预测 4.8%，基本通胀 1.7%，失业率 3.8%。首十个月已有 121 间公司在港上市，集资逾 4,000 亿元。陈茂波提出港加三方面合作：资本方面，加拿大目标五年内在当地带动 1 万亿加元投资，香港管理资产约 42 万亿港元，家族办公室逾 3,300 间；资源方面，加拿大每月向亚洲出口约 100 万吨液化天然气，香港正发展黄金及商品交易能力；创新及人才方面，自 2022 年底以来已有逾 32 万人经人才计划来港。他亦提到，约 30 万名加拿大人居港，中加在深圳亚太经合组织会议期间同意扩大关税减免，并将贸易安排延长至 2028 年底。

summary.en: Chief Secretary for Administration Eric Chan Kwok-ki today chaired the first meeting of the Working Group on Coordination of AI Risk Governance, set up under the Policy Address to co-ordinate the AI risk-governance strategy across bureaux. The meeting reviewed work plans for seven specific actions: combating AI-enabled crime, better protecting minor users, market assessment of AI ethical risks, safe and orderly AI use across industries, legal liability for accidents caused by AI products, guidelines on AI-agent management, and AI's impact on employment. Members include the Secretaries for Justice, Education, Financial Services and the Treasury, Innovation and Technology, Labour and Welfare, and Security, the Head of the Chief Executive's Policy Unit and the Commissioner for Digital Policy; the group will meet regularly to oversee implementation. Chan said AI is developing fast and, while it upgrades industry and daily life, risk governance and application safety are equally crucial, with the aim of technology for good that is safe and under control while accelerating AI adoption.

summary.en: Vitasoy International's interim profit for the six months to the end of September rose nearly 8% year on year to HK$185 million, up about 3% excluding currency effects, with an interim dividend of 4 cents per share maintained. Revenue for the half year was HK$3.337 billion, up 3% year on year and down 1% excluding currency effects; gross margin widened 0.8 percentage points to 51.9%, helped by currency movements, lower raw-material costs and improved production efficiency, partly offset by higher trade promotion spending. summary.en: The Health Bureau has announced that Hong Kong, China has formally joined the International Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (ICH) as a regulatory member, represented by the Hong Kong Pharmacy and Poisons Board. The ICH approved the decision at its assembly in Czechia on November 17, making Hong Kong, China its 20th regulatory member. Hong Kong became an ICH observer on October 31, 2023 and reached full membership in just three years, far faster than the government's earlier estimate of eight to ten years. Secretary for Health Professor Lo Chung-mau said membership will help develop Hong Kong's capacity and mechanisms for "first-tier approval" of innovative drugs and deepen participation in setting international rules for drug research and registration. The government will set up a Centre for Medical Products Regulation next month to build independent drug evaluation and approval capability.

summary.en: The volume of retired electric-vehicle batteries is expected to rise from about 1,300 tonnes this year to about 6,700 tonnes in 2030. The Environment and Ecology Bureau has submitted a paper to the Legislative Council proposing a producer responsibility scheme for EV batteries, charging EV suppliers a recycling levy based on battery weight, starting at HK$6 per kilogram and rising steadily each year. For a typical private car with a 500-kilogram battery, the starting charge would be about HK$3,000, rising by HK$800 a year to HK$15,000 by 2043. The scheme covers power batteries of battery-electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles, including private cars, taxis, motorcycles and electric commercial vehicles other than franchised buses. The government aims to submit an amendment bill to the Legislative Council next year, enter a preparatory phase in 2028 and roll the scheme out fully in 2029. More than 180,000 EVs already distributed before the scheme starts will be exempt, and owners who replace a battery or scrap a vehicle can enjoy one free recycling and vehicle deregistration.

summary.en: Jared Kushner, son-in-law of US President Donald Trump and his special envoy, said Russia has agreed to European participation in a multilateral negotiating mechanism, adding that restarting direct dialogue between Europe and Russia is especially important. A summit of the UK- and France-led "Coalition of the Willing" supporting Ukraine was held in Berlin, where Kushner told a press conference afterwards that Russia could accept Ukraine receiving security guarantees similar to NATO's Article 5 collective defence clause, while also expressing a desire for no new conflict to break out. Kushner stressed that such guarantees would need a mechanism covering monitoring and verification, deterrence and other measures, and that Trump is open to this provided it serves US interests. Neither the United States nor the European Union is a member of the coalition, but special envoy Steve Witkoff, European Council President Antonio Costa, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte also attended. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Europe must be included in the peace talks, and it is not yet clear how NATO Article 5-style security guarantees would work.
summary.zh_hans: 美国总统特朗普女婿、特使库什纳表示，俄罗斯已同意欧洲参加多边谈判机制，重重启欧洲与俄罗斯直接对话尤其重要。英法牵头、旨在支援乌克兰的「志愿联盟」峰会在德国柏林召开，库什纳在会后记者会上说，俄方能接受乌克兰获得类似北约第五条集体防御条款的安全保障，同时表达不再爆发新冲突的意愿。库什纳强调相关安全保障需要建立涵盖监督核查、威慑等措施的机制，特朗普对此持开放态度，但前提必须符合美国利益。美国及欧盟都不是「志愿联盟」成员，但特使威特科夫、欧洲理事会主席科斯塔、欧委会主席冯德莱恩及北约秘书长吕特亦有出席。乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示欧洲必须被纳入和平谈判，暂时不清楚类似北约第五条的安全保障将如何运作。
summary.zh_hant: 美國總統特朗普女婿、特使庫什納表示，俄羅斯已同意歐洲參加多邊談判機制，重啟歐洲與俄羅斯直接對話尤其重要。英法牽頭、旨在支援烏克蘭的「志願聯盟」峰會在德國柏林召開，庫什納在會後記者會上說，俄方能接受烏克蘭獲得類似北約第五條集體防禦條款的安全保障，同時表達不再爆發新衝突的意願。庫什納強調相關安全保障需要建立涵蓋監督核查、威懾等措施的機制，特朗普對此持開放態度，但前提必須符合美國利益。美國及歐盟都不是「志願聯盟」成員，但特使威特科夫、歐洲理事會主席科斯塔、歐委會主席馮德萊恩及北約秘書長呂特亦有出席。烏克蘭總統澤連斯基表示歐洲必須被納入和平談判，暫時不清楚類似北約第五條的安全保障將如何運作。

summary.en: The government plans to set up a Building Maintenance Support and Services Bureau, with the Development Bureau submitting a funding paper to the Legislative Council. The bureau follows the government's announcement after the Wang Fuk Court fire that it would be established before the end of the year. The remaining balance of about HK$113 million from the "Bid Smart" scheme will go to the new bureau, on top of HK$300 million earmarked by the government, bringing the total to about HK$413 million. Of that, HK$313 million will fund fee waivers, initially focused on buildings under "Operation Building Bright 2.0", covering about 80% of private residential and composite buildings aged 30 years or more; owners of the remaining 20% of higher-value buildings would pay in full. The bureau aims to complete company registration and appoint its board within next month, with the first case-management team starting work then to contact owners of about 1,800 outstanding maintenance cases under "Bid Smart" that have yet to appoint contractors.

summary.en: The leaders of China, Russia and the United States held a historic meeting yesterday and issued a Peace Declaration, saying the three countries, as permanent members of the UN Security Council, are committed to advancing UN reform. summary.en: Hong Kong turned markedly colder this morning, with the Observatory recording a minimum temperature of 15.3°C as of 5:30am, the lowest since autumn began. The Observatory said a strong northeast monsoon and a band of cloud and rain are affecting the Guangdong coast, with cloudy skies and a few showers expected today; daytime temperatures in the urban areas will range from 14 to 16 degrees, one or two degrees lower in the New Territories, where some areas and high ground will feel cold. The public is advised to keep warm.

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has said he will not rush into a decision on the next steps over Iran before the New Year. Axios analysed that the timing could mean Trump wants to give the US naval blockade and economic pressure on Iran more time to take effect, and could also signal that, if Iran does not yield before the end of the year, he wants enough time to take military action before the new Democrat-controlled Congress takes office. The report added that Trump faces huge pressure from Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who is urging him to launch a decisive bombing campaign against Iran as soon as possible.

summary.en: US stocks closed sharply lower, with all three major indices down more than 2%, as Anthropic's first day of trading failed to lift the market and AI shares came under broad pressure. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell below 50,000 for the first time since June, closing near its low of the day at 49,097, down 1,101 points or about 2.2%, its fourth straight daily loss and its lowest close in more than six months. The S&P 500 fell for a sixth straight day to 7,175, down 147 points or 2%, its lowest in nearly seven months, while the Nasdaq dropped 550 points or nearly 2.3% to 23,879, its lowest in more than seven months. Anthropic's listing is the largest IPO in history by fundraising size; its shares peaked at US$115.1, nearly 39% above the US$83 offer price, with its market value briefly topping US$2 trillion, before closing at US$97.17, up more than 17% on the day. Nvidia fell more than 3% to US$145.98, its sixth straight decline and its first close below US$150 in about a year and a half, while AMD fell nearly 8% after being targeted by a short seller, having dropped more than 11% at one point.

summary.en: Mongolia's parliament has voted to approve President Ukhnaagiin Khurelsukh's resignation, with 96 of the 104 voting members backing the motion. It is the first time in Mongolia's history that a sitting president has voluntarily stepped down early. Under the constitution, the parliament speaker will act as president until a new president is sworn in, and parliament must call a presidential election within four months. Khurelsukh, elected in 2021, announced his resignation on November 17. He has denied allegations of abuse of power and corruption, saying he made no policy mistakes and never took state or public property.

summary.en: Denmark's parliament has passed a security and defence agreement covering Greenland, its autonomous territory. Signed in September this year by Denmark, Greenland and the United States at the United Nations headquarters in New York, the deal revises the 1951 US-Denmark defence agreement, allowing the US to set up new defence areas in Greenland, upgrade facilities and expand military operations. summary.en: The HKSAR Government today issued a statement strongly condemning and firmly refuting the 2026 report of the United States-China Economic and Security Review Commission, calling its contents untrue and biased, smearing "One Country, Two Systems" and Hong Kong's national security laws, and interfering in Hong Kong affairs. The Government reiterated that Hong Kong is an inalienable part of China, enjoying a high degree of autonomy under "One Country, Two Systems", with residents' rights protected by the Constitution and the Basic Law, an independent judiciary and a solid rule of law. The statement also rebutted the report's claims on the Lai Chee-ying case, the Hong Kong Alliance case and the Wong Chi-fung case one by one, stressing the courts decided each strictly on the evidence and the law, with Wong sentenced to 10 years' imprisonment after pleading guilty. The Government urged the US to stop interfering in Hong Kong affairs, noting the US has run a trade surplus of more than US$250 billion with Hong Kong over the past decade and about 1,550 US companies operate in the city.

summary.en: Hong Kong's uncertificated securities market regime took effect this week, and HKEX has updated the list of securities expected to join the paperless system, with the first batch covering five listed companies: HKEX, Television Broadcasts (TVB), China Resources Power, Xiang China International and Min Xin Group. HKEX shares will join the paperless system from February 16 next year, while China Resources Power and Xiang China International will join in March. Under HKEX guidance, listed shares must join the paperless system within five years from November 16, 2026, but investors do not need to rush to convert physical certificates and should watch for announcements from the companies they hold. Investors may open a USI (Uncertificated Securities Market) account with an approved share registrar to hold and manage shares electronically in their own names.

summary.en: A strong northeast monsoon has driven temperatures sharply down, with the Observatory recording a low of 12.7°C as of 4pm today — the lowest since autumn — while the Cold Weather Warning and the Strong Monsoon Signal are in force. Urban temperatures are expected to fall to about 13°C tonight and tomorrow, a few degrees lower in the New Territories, before recovering to around 21°C during the day tomorrow, with a slight rebound over the next day or two and another drop mid-next week. The Home Affairs Department has opened 18 temporary cold shelters, which stay open while the Cold Weather Warning is in force and provide free bedding, hot meals and hot water; the public can call 2572 8427 for enquiries.

summary.en: The Centre for Health Protection announced today that from November 13 to 19, Hong Kong recorded two imported dengue fever cases, with the patients having visited Vietnam and Cambodia respectively during the incubation period, and one imported chikungunya fever case involving a 71-year-old man who had visited the mainland and is now in stable condition. Hong Kong has recorded 42 dengue cases so far this year, comprising 40 imported and two local cases, and nine confirmed chikungunya cases, including eight imported and one local. The Centre reminded the public to guard against mosquito bites and clear stagnant water, both at home and when travelling, and to use DEET-containing insect repellents properly.

summary.en: A woman was sentenced today at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts to six months' imprisonment for illegally importing 38,000 alternative smoking products. The Department of Health's Tobacco and Alcohol Control Office was notified by Customs yesterday that the products had been intercepted in the luggage of the woman arriving from Japan, and immediately arrested and prosecuted her. Since September 19, when amendments to the Tobacco Control Legislation conferred arrest powers on tobacco control inspectors, the office has prosecuted 34 cases involving the importation of large quantities of alternative smoking products, with 37 people convicted and sentenced to between four weeks and eight months in prison. Under the Import and Export Ordinance, importing alternative smoking products carries a maximum penalty of a HK$2 million fine and seven years' imprisonment on indictment.

summary.en: Narcotics Bureau officers raided a squatter hut in Pat Heung, Yuen Long, early this morning, arresting two men and seizing about 1kg of suspected methamphetamine and drug packaging tools. Officers then searched two drug warehouses in Kam Sheung Road's Ngau Keng and Tin Shui Wai's Shek Kong Tsuen, seizing about 26kg more of suspected methamphetamine. In total the operation netted about 27kg of suspected meth, with an estimated street value of about HK$12 million. The two arrested men, aged 34 and 39 and both Nigerian nationals holding recognisance forms, will be charged with three counts of trafficking in a dangerous drug and appear at Sha Tin Magistrates' Courts tomorrow.

summary.en: The Government gazetted the Virtual Asset Services Legislation (Amendment) Bill 2026 today, expanding the regulatory regime for virtual asset services to four additional types of services — dealing, advisory, management and custody — with providers required to be licensed by or registered with the Securities and Futures Commission and to pass a fit-and-proper test. Banks and stored value facility licensees regulated by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority must also register with the SFC if they offer virtual asset services in Hong Kong. The bill amends the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance and empowers the SFC and the HKMA to implement the regime; it will be introduced to the Legislative Council for first reading on December 2. Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui said the regime follows the "same activity, same risks, same regulation" principle and is a key step towards a world-leading digital asset regulatory regime.
summary.zh_hans: 政府今日刊宪《2026年虚拟资产服务法例（修订）条例草案》，将虚拟资产服务监管制度扩大至交易、提供意见、管理及托管四类新增服务，相关服务提供者须向证监会领牌或注册，并须通过适当人选测试。受金管局监管的银行及储值支付工具持牌人如在港提供虚拟资产服务，亦须向证监会注册。条例草案将修订《打击洗钱及恐怖分子资金筹集条例》，并赋权证监会及金管局实施新制度，12月2日提交立法会首读。财经事务及库务局局长许正宇表示，新制度贯彻「相同活动、相同风险、相同监管」原则，是建立世界领先数码资产监管制度的关键一步。
summary.zh_hant: 政府今日刊憲《2026年虛擬資產服務法例（修訂）條例草案》，將虛擬資產服務監管制度擴大至交易、提供意見、管理及託管四類新增服務，相關服務提供者須向證監會領牌或註冊，並須通過適當人選測試。受金管局監管的銀行及儲值支付工具持牌人如在港提供虛擬資產服務，亦須向證監會註冊。條例草案將修訂《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》，並賦權證監會及金管局實施新制度，12月2日提交立法會首讀。財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇表示，新制度貫徹「相同活動、相同風險、相同監管」原則，是建立世界領先數碼資產監管制度的關鍵一步。

summary.en: The Centa-City Leading Index, which tracks Hong Kong second-hand home prices, fell 0.66% week on week to 157.56, a sixth consecutive weekly decline and a cumulative drop of 2.26% to a near six-month low. Prices of large estates and small-to-medium units both fell more than 0.7% to over six-month lows, while large units fell more than 0.4% to a near four-month low; all four districts fell, with the New Territories East down nearly 2.6%. Centaline Property said weak Hong Kong stocks and rising expectations of a December rate hike could push the index down another 1.6% by year-end, back to late-April levels.

summary.en: Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki said that with the Wang Fuk Court fire approaching its first anniversary, any memorial activity that is lawful will be absolutely allowed by the Government, which will not stop or obstruct residents from holding memorials, in response to a group cancelling a planned memorial event. He cautioned that some people online with ulterior motives are trying to exploit memorial activities to cause disruption, urging the public to choose carefully and not be used, and said police will deal with any unlawful acts according to the law. Chan also expressed deep condolences to the victims, especially families who lost loved ones, and said the Government is doing its utmost to help them rebuild their homes and is pursuing comprehensive systemic reform based on the independent committee's report.

summary.en: Twenty-eight landlords of subdivided units pleaded guilty at the Eastern Magistrates' Courts today to breaching Part IVA of the Landlord and Tenant (Consolidation) Ordinance and were fined between $800 and $13,600, amounting to $112,500 in total. Their offences included failing to submit a Notice of Tenancy to the Rating and Valuation Department within 60 days of the regulated tenancy commencing, failing to produce bills and written accounts when asking tenants to pay apportioned water and electricity charges, and charging second-term rent above the statutory cap. summary.en: Water pipes burst at Fu Bao Gardens in Ma On Shan at around 4am today, cutting fresh and flushing water to all 12 blocks — about 4,200 households. summary.en: The Government has proposed amending the Buildings Ordinance to raise penalties for unauthorised building works. Unauthorised works that are neither "designated exempted works" nor verified face a new $10,000 fixed penalty for failing to comply with a removal order; continued non-compliance can lead to prosecution, with a maximum fine of $200,000 and one year's imprisonment on first conviction, rising to $400,000 and one year's imprisonment on a subsequent conviction. For serious "specified unauthorised building works" such as unauthorised basements, the maximum penalty rises to $300,000 and two years' imprisonment, and $600,000 and two years' imprisonment for repeat offences. As of September this year, about 64,800 unauthorised works were subject to overdue removal orders. The Government plans to introduce the bill to the Legislative Council in January next year and aims to complete legislation by mid-year.

summary.en: Yoga instructor Chow Wai-yin, 23, was found dead in a hotel room bathtub in Tsim Sha Tsui four years ago with about 42 stab wounds. summary.en: The International Court of Justice has ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya minority in its 2017 crackdown, the first time the United Nations' highest court has found a sovereign state guilty of genocide. The court detailed atrocities including security forces killing thousands of civilians, widespread sexual violence against women and extreme violence against children, and ordered Myanmar to allow and assist those who fled to return home safely, voluntarily and with dignity, and to investigate and punish those responsible, with compensation to be decided later. Human rights groups and Rohingya communities welcomed the ruling; Britain's foreign secretary announced the expulsion of Myanmar's military attache in London, summoned its charge d'affaires and foreshadowed further sanctions in the coming days.

summary.zh_hant: 國際法院裁定，緬甸在2017年鎮壓行動中對境內羅興亞少數族群犯下種族滅絕罪行，是聯合國最高司法機構首次認定一個主權國家犯下種族滅絕。法院詳述緬甸對羅興亞少數族群的暴行，包括安全部隊殺害以千計平民，對婦女實施廣泛性暴力，並對兒童施加極端暴力；法院下令緬甸必須批准並協助因暴力逃離家園的民眾安全、自願並有尊嚴地返回原居地，調查及懲處涉事者，賠償問題將於日後決定。多個人權組織及羅興亞社群歡迎裁決；英國外相宣布驅逐緬甸駐英武官，並傳召緬甸臨時代辦，預告未來幾日會有進一步制裁行動。
